page.layout: One column of Latin verse, set full width, with indented lines in the printed manner. Running head at top left, page number at top right. No marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword or signature.

p.i: Illúmque armatis urbibus expulit, Minata cædes vinclàque turpia, Durisq;, cedentem procellis Signa sequi Lotharena iussit. Sed magna Regis mens violentiam, Sævósque fortis contudit impetus, Virésque prouisis minores Consiliis melior subegit. Sic sic minantes exitium Iouí Pallas Gigantes Ægide perdidit: Quum fulminantem iuuit illa Consilio potiore patrem. Non vis furenti profuit impia Turbæ, nec Offæ Pelion insitus. Vis sola conatúsque semper Mole ruunt propria nefasti. Nunc fraudulentis hostibus obrutis, Rex magne, motus discute turbidos: Pacémque languenti benignus Perpetuam patriæ redona. Nam tota cunctis urbibus ingemit Oppressa diris Gallia cladibus, Tristésque mactatis cruenta Ciuibus ingeminat querelas. Franciscus ex quo mollia turpiter Euertit audax otia Guisius, Belliqué ciuilis scelestus Francigenas violauit author.

page.notes: Verse is printed with indented lines in one run; I have kept the line breaks within one paragraph. Doubtful readings: "Illúmque" accent as printed; "Iouí" (final letter could be Iouis) [?] not marked in text because the form is clear enough; "Turbæ" is printed with a ligature-like sign, read as æ; "Durisq;" q with a sign; "mactatis" printed with a ligature-like form, read as mactatis. Long s normalised to s; u/v and i/j normalised. Greek or Hebrew: none.
